name: Physical Abuse In Marriage
overview: Scripture affirms the sacred unity of marriage, where a man and wife become one flesh and are to cherish one another, rejoicing in their covenant relationship (Genesis 2:24; Proverbs 5:18). God values the marriage bond deeply, hating treachery and violence within it, and calls husbands to treat their wives with faithfulness and honor (Malachi 2:16; Proverbs 18:22). The holiness of marriage is emphasized by prohibitions against adultery and wrongful divorce, underscoring the commitment to protect and uphold the marriage covenant (Exodus 20:14; Matthew 5:32). Physical abuse in marriage violates these biblical principles of love, unity, and respect within the marriage relationship.
